meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文平台热门题材与趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写短篇网文需要知道当下什么题材最火
copy.tagline_en: Track trending topics and genres on short-story platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short stories and need to know what's trending

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成短篇网文市场分析师。它能分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的热门短篇数据，帮你捕捉当前流行的题材和情绪方向，并输出扫榜报告。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜，或说“短篇什么火”“知乎故事排行”时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言最近什么短篇最火。
我想写短篇，但没方向，帮我看看七猫短篇的趋势。
say.note: Claude 会做全榜概览，找出当前风口题材。

say.text: 对比一下知乎盐言和黑岩短篇的题材差异。
say.note: Claude 会做跨平台对比分析，输出平台特性差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a short-story market analyst. It can analyze popular short-story data from platforms like Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, and Dianzhong, helping you identify trending themes and emotional directions, and output a scanning report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you input /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, or say "What short stories are popular?" or "Zhihu story ranking."

say_en.text: Scan the latest popular short stories on Zhihu Yanyan for me.
I want to write a short story but have no direction. Check Qimao short story trends.
Compare the theme differences between Zhihu Yanyan and Heiyan short stories.
